Here's the full flow to create a source in SailPoint ISC and trigger an account aggregation against it.

---

## Step 1 — Get an OAuth2 Bearer Token

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id={CLIENT_ID}
&client_secret={CLIENT_SECRET}
```

Save the `access_token` from the response. Every call below uses `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}`.

---

## Step 2 — Create the Source

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/sources
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "name": "HR CSV Feed",
  "description": "Flat-file employee feed from HR",
  "type": "Delimited File",
  "connectorId": "delimited-file",
  "owner": {
    "type": "IDENTITY",
    "id": "<owner-identity-id>",
    "name": "Jane Smith"
  },
  "connectorAttributes": {
    "delimChar": ",",
    "hasHeader": true,
    "mergeColumns": false
  }
}
```

Key fields:
- `connectorId` — the connector plugin name (e.g. `delimited-file`, `active-directory`, `jdbc`, etc.)
- `owner.id` — the ISC identity ID of the source owner (required)
- `type` — human-readable label that must match the connector

The response body includes the new source's `id` — save it as `{sourceId}`.

---

## Step 3 — Upload or Confirm Connector Config (if needed)

For most direct connectors you'll also `PATCH` or `PUT` connector-specific attributes. For a flat file, you'd upload the CSV separately. This step is connector-dependent; skip it for connectors that pull data remotely.

---

## Step 4 — Trigger Account Aggregation

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "disableOptimization": false
}
```

`disableOptimization: false` means ISC will use delta detection where supported. Set it to `true` to force a full load.

The response returns a task object — save the `task.id` (a UUID).

```json
{
  "id": "<task-id>",
  "type": "QUARTZ",
  "uniqueName": "ACCOUNTS_AGGREGATION",
  "description": "...",
  "launcher": "...",
  "created": "...",
  "modified": "...",
  "launched": "...",
  "completed": null,
  "completionStatus": null,
  "messages": [],
  "returns": [],
  "attributes": { ... },
  "progress": "STARTED"
}
```

---

## Step 5 — Poll Aggregation Status

```bash
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/task-status/{taskId}
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

Poll until `completionStatus` is `SUCCESS`, `WARNING`, or `ERROR`. The `returns` array will contain stats like `total`, `created`, `updated`, `deleted` once complete.

---

## Quick Reference

| # | Method | Path |
|---|--------|------|
| 1 | POST | `/oauth/token` |
| 2 | POST | `/v3/sources` |
| 3 | POST | `/v3/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts` |
| 4 | GET  | `/v3/task-status/{taskId}` |

---

  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/sources
    api_version: v3
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
    api_version: v3

    path: /v3/task-status/{taskId}
    api_version: v3

  - name
